name: web-dark-hero-with-peach-gradient-keyword-and-avatar-rating-strip
title: Black hero 'Build sites that sell well.' with a peach gradient second line, a sparkle badge, two buttons and an avatar and stars strip
whatItIs: A black page with a dark badge 'Introducing Sparkles' with an arrow, a heavy white headline whose second line is peach, a grey paragraph mentioning React and Vue.js in bold, a white pill button 'Get lifetime access — $59' and an outlined 'Explore components', and below a row of overlapping avatars with five yellow stars and 'Trusted by 400+ users'.
whatItMeans: Direct and warm; a peach keyword softens a stark black hero.
techniques: Colour the second headline line in a soft gradient.
Use a badge above the headline.
Pair a white filled and an outlined button.
Add an avatar and stars strip for trust.

vocabulary.definition: A headline phrase filled with a gradient.
A pill announcing news with an arrow.
A filled and an outlined button.
